text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, as I'm walking along the
river...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna have a one-off,
all-or-nothin'. No
whinin' if you lose, all
right?

text_block_list.name: Figure in Black A
text_block_list.text:
Tch, watch how you speak to Her
Holiness!

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Hush, now. It seems that we have a
guest... Not
just some stray, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What do I find but a standoff between
an
Umamusume in a Tracen Academy
uniform and a
lady with an entourage of
figures in black!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That badge... Heh. You're from the
academy.
choice_data_list_en: What on earth is going on here!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone just relax. That goes for you
too,
Trainer. We're just gonna have a
friendly game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's just a regular bout of Concentration,
me
versus her.

text_block_list.name: Figure in Black B
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any idea how lucky you
are? Even
VIPs need to wait their turn
for an audience with
Her Holi—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... Is that something you can just
freely
disclose to a random passerby?

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
Ah yes, you're right... Come now,
everyone. Let's
not trouble this
law-abiding citizen. This is a
match
between the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, there ya have it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Turn around and get going, before ya
find
yourself in too deep.

text_block_list.name: Figures in Black
choice_data_list_en: Won't be able to go back...? What do you mean...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I mean, take a good look around you. Ya
don't
belong here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If ya get what I'm sayin', scurry on home.
You
wouldn't wanna go and spoil that
nice career of
yours, would ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The line of black-clad figures continues
to glare
at me. If looks could kill... It
seems like they might
actually be
denizens of society's underbelly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, a Tracen Academy student is
right here
in front of me. I have no doubt
she runs to realize
her dreams. As a
trainer, there's only one thing I
can do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, a Tracen Academy student is
right here
in front of me. I have no doubt
she runs to realize
her dreams. As a
trainer, there's only one thing I
can do...
choice_data_list: 見過ごせない！俺が君の代わりになる！
見過ごせない！私が貴方の代わりになる！
choice_data_list_en: I can't just overlook this! I'll take your place!
I can't just overlook this! I'll take your place!
We're running away with all our might!
Let's run away with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Um, were ya listening to a single word
I said?
choice_data_list: 見過ごせない！俺が君の代わりになる！
見過ごせない！私が貴方の代わりになる！
choice_data_list_en: I can't just overlook this! I'll take your place!
I can't just overlook this! I'll take your place!
We're running away with all our might!
Let's run away with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Drop the act. Ya don't have what it
takes to help
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: でもウマ娘を守るのがトレーナーなんだ！
でもウマ娘を守るのがトレーナーだから！
choice_data_list_en: But a trainer is supposed to protect Uma Musume!
But it's a trainer's job to protect Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're no more than a fool if you'd go to
such
lengths for someone you just met.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You're just intent on putting a damper
on
things, huh?
choice_data_list: それでも俺が身代わりになる！
それでも私が身代わりになる！
choice_data_list_en: Even so, I'll take your place!
Even so, I'll take your place!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm outta here. It seems today's not the
day.

text_block_list.name: Figure in Black C
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What the hell? You said this was
the only
day you had time!

text_block_list.name: Angel of the Night
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind. There's no point if you're
not in
the mood for it. After all, I want
to face you at
your best.

text_block_list.name: Figure in Black B
text_block_list.text: ...If that's how you feel...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My game was interrupted and I've got
practically
nothing to show for it. What a
waste of a night.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Still, it's been some time since I saw a scene like that... Heh. See ya around, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Leggo of me! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Figures in Black
text_block_list.text:
Where'd they go?! Leave no stone
unturned!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch! The hell'd ya do that for?! Things
were just
about to get interesting! I was
right on the edge!
choice_data_list: ま、まだ追いかけてくる……！

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Whaddya mean?
choice_data_list: むしろ今の方がギリギリだよ……
choice_data_list_en: Honestly, it's even closer to the wire now...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: だって捕まったら、大変そうだろ？
だって捕まったら、大変そうじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Because if we get caught, we'll be in trouble, won't we?
Because if we get caught, wouldn't we be in trouble?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Hahaha! Looks like we really are
cut from
the same cloth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoa!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thrilling stuff. We either make a clean
getaway or
we get caught. A nice and
simple gamble with
everything on the
line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...And we've crossed the finish line. I've
pulled off
a daring escape, joined by an
addlebrained
trainer... Haha.
